title: Brain made up of two distinct organs evolving independently
description: Scientists have discovered the brain is made of separate systems, solving a longstanding riddle and aiding research into diseases like ALS
content:
The brain is two separate organs that evolved independently and are now “cleverly packaged together” in our skulls, rather than existing as a single unit, scientists have said.
